context: Tatsuya-country teaches Ren how to play harmonica during a break.
purpose: Elder showing young man rural instrument.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Warm, unhurried introduction. Soft Tohoku drawl. Gentle lift on the word itself—he's offering something precious. Settles into stillness after, letting Ren decide.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll try playing it for the first time.
lines.style: Careful, almost reverent. Hesitant exhale before beginning. Eyes on the instrument. Warm curiosity—not performing excitement, but genuine attention.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: Yeah, it's simple at the start.
lines.style: Steady reassurance. Light, unhurried pace. No performance of encouragement—just fact delivered as a gift. Slight settling-down at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Genuine surprise breaking through. Quick bright attack on the first syllable. Small, real laugh underneath. Not theatrical—the delight of discovery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ええなぁ、続けたらええで。
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. The words simple, the delivery weighted with approval. Slow pace. A pause before 'keep at it'—he's seeing something in Ren.
